Inspect a model

Source: R/model.R
pmx_inspect.Rd

pmx_parameters() returns the fixed effects, pmx_omega() the between-subject variability matrix, and pmx_ode() the differential equations of an ODE model.

Usage

pmx_parameters(model)

pmx_omega(model, values = c("estimate", "init"))

pmx_ode(model)

Arguments

model

A model read by one of the pmx_read_*() functions.

values

For pmx_omega(): "estimate" (the default) or "init".

Value

  • pmx_parameters(): a data frame with one row per fixed effect and columns name (the tool's name), role ("clearance", "volume", "ka" or "other"), init, lower, upper, fixed, and estimate (NA when the model was read without estimates).

  • pmx_omega(): a symmetric matrix with the random effects' names as dimnames, built block-diagonally from the model's omega blocks. With values = "estimate", a block read with estimates contributes them and any other block its initial values.

  • pmx_ode(): a named list of expressions, one derivative per compartment, or NULL for a closed-form model.
